# seekrit_service_token (Resource)

A seekrit service token. The provider mints the keypair and token string locally; the server only ever receives the hash and public key. The secret `token` is returned once and stored (sensitive) in Terraform state — like any Terraform-created credential (e.g. `aws_iam_access_key.secret`). Use an encrypted state backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A runtime credential for one environment. Binding it to the environment lets
# `GET /v1/resolve` work without naming one; the grant below is what lets it
# decrypt. Both are needed — a bound token with no grant authenticates and then
# resolves nothing.
resource "seekrit_service_token" "ci" {
  name           = "ci-deploy"
  role           = "member"
  environment_id = seekrit_environment.production.id
  expires_at     = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

resource "seekrit_environment_key_grant" "ci_production" {
  environment_id = seekrit_environment.production.id
  principal_type = "service_token"
  principal_id   = seekrit_service_token.ci.id
}

# The token string is returned once, at creation. It is stored in Terraform
# state (sensitive) — unavoidable for a resource that mints a credential, the
# same as `aws_iam_access_key.secret`. Use an encrypted state backend.
output "ci_token" {
  value     = seekrit_service_token.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable token name (editable in place).

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) The application environment (`env_…`) this token is bound to. Immutable — changing it mints a new token.
- `expires_at` (String) Optional expiry (ISO 8601). Immutable — changing it mints a new token.
- `role` (String) Org capability: `member` (default) or `admin`. Immutable — changing it mints a new token.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (ISO 8601).
- `id` (String) The public token id (`skt_…`).
- `public_key_jwk` (String) The token's public key (JWK), used to wrap DEK grants for it.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The full secret token string (`skt_…_…`), returned only at creation.
- `token_hash` (String) SHA-256 (base64url) of the token — what the server stores.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Tokens import by id — but the secret string is unrecoverable, so `token` and
# `token_hash` stay null afterwards. An imported token can be renamed and
# revoked from Terraform; it cannot be handed to a consumer again.
terraform import seekrit_service_token.ci skt_4kQ9wPzMv2LbTx7RnAcYdH
```
